name: improve-skill
description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "improve a skill", "make this skill better", "add features to a skill", "this skill is missing something", "upgrade my skill", "what's missing from this skill", "the skill doesn't do X", "make this more useful", or wants to improve skill effectiveness rather than structural correctness. Not for structural fixes — use repair-skill. Not for agents.

findings.excerpt: Use Task tool with subagent_type=claude-code-guide — faster and more accurate than WebSearch.
Use WebSearch or WebFetch against official documentation.
